data: What is the approximate BLI (mrr) value for the green dashed line at a window size of 10 for the VERB plot?

The question asks for the approximate BLI (mrr) value for the green dashed line at a window size of 10 for the VERB plot. From the caption, we know that the green dashed line represents ru. In the VERB plot, the green dashed line intersects with the x-axis at approximately 0.2. Therefore, the approximate BLI (mrr) value for the green dashed line at a window size of 10 for the VERB plot is 0.2.
